name: Model Training Graphviz
description: Training-time wrapper for model architecture graphs. The shell is DOM/CSS, while SVG geometry, hierarchy, node color, edge tags, hover evidence, pan/zoom, selected/related emphasis, and phase focus are delegated to patterns/model-graphviz/pattern.js. The standalone preview now uses a compact Pangu MoE training graph aligned with the model-architecture gallery style: neutral IO/weight tensors, parameters on the left input lane, runtime state/cache on the right auxiliary lane, and module/operator colors from modelArchitectureColormap().

typography.dataVizExceptionReason: Training edge tags are SVG marks coupled to the zoomable base graph geometry.
typography.dataVizFallback: Command-wheel zoom and hover evidence panels expose the full edge meaning at a readable scale.

examples.notes: Standalone design-system preview for training evidence overlays. It uses the same compact Pangu MoE graph silhouette as the model architecture gallery, then adds phase tabs, edge tags, and hover evidence through PtoModelTrainingGraphvizPattern.

classification: hybrid-pattern: DOM preview shell plus renderer-driven SVG graph. model-training-graphviz must stay a thin wrapper around model-graphviz renderController; it must not fork the base graph controller or geometry math.

dataContract.graph: Same node/edge/cluster graph object accepted by model-graphviz.

relatedNodeIds: node ids to keep highlighted with this node

dataContract.laneSemantics: Weight/Parameter tensors belong on the left input lane. Runtime State/Cache tensors belong on the right auxiliary lane. Modules or operators may branch right when they are alternative compute paths, but their weights stay on the left.
dataContract.hierarchy: Clusters may define parent, children, and nodes arrays; nodes may define parent. The shared model-graphviz controller uses these relationships for drill-down selection and ancestor/descendant emphasis.
dataContract.edgeTags: Edges may define tag, edgeType, edgeTypeLabel to render compact evidence labels through model-graphviz. Edges may also define sourceAnchor, targetAnchor, curve, and tagPosition when a fork/join needs stable branch routing.
dataContract.phaseMap: Training pages call controller.setPhase({ nodeId, relatedNodeIds }) when a workflow phase changes. Phase changes must not refit or pan the viewport.

useWhen: showing how a training phase maps to architecture nodes without moving the graph viewport
overlaying source/config/profiling evidence in hover panels while graph nodes stay tensor/module/operator based
connecting training run steps, loss/MFU curves, or hardware evidence to architecture nodes
teaching Dense, MoE, MLA, DSA, router, expert, and LM Head training bottlenecks
allowedOverrides: graph data, node labels, cluster labels, edge tags, training evidence copy, and selected node ids
model-specific phase maps from training workflow names to graph node ids
viewport padding and initial selected node
model-graphviz renderController options such as evidenceMap, hover rendering, selected/related class names, and pan/zoom fit options
node fill colors through the base model-graphviz colormap only
source/config/profiling evidence as hover metadata or page-side evidence panels
forbiddenOverrides: reimplementing model node geometry outside model-graphviz
using an iframe page shell when the product needs direct phase-node linkage
moving the viewport when phase steps advance; selection should only change node and edge emphasis
dimming non-selected operators or tensor nodes with low opacity during phase changes
drawing tall source-evidence columns inside the architecture graph
using source files such as config.json or modeling.py as input/output tensor nodes
promoting training evidence priority or business severity into graph badges
using saturated blue borders as the main selected state in light mode
creating native title tooltips in addition to the custom hover panel
drawing edge tags or evidence badges from static HTML rather than model-graphviz renderer output
reintroducing a second local graph controller for hover, edge tags, pan/zoom, or related-node emphasis inside model-training-graphviz
placing Parameter/Weight tensors on the right auxiliary lane unless the actual graph semantics make them runtime state
agentReuseRule: Load model-graphviz/pattern.css and pattern.js first, then model-training-graphviz/pattern.css and pattern.js. Call PtoModelTrainingGraphvizPattern.render with a model-graphviz graph object plus trainingEvidence. Prefer PtoModelGraphvizPattern.modelArchitectureColormap(graph) for model architecture visuals. Preserve controller.setPhase({ nodeId, relatedNodeIds }) for training-step linkage. Do not refit or pan the graph when phases change, and do not duplicate base controller behavior locally.
